title: Student Productivity App
shortDesc: Lightweight cross-platform productivity app for students — tasks, notes, expenses and analytics.
longDesc: Student Productivity App is a lightweight, cross-platform productivity application built with React Native and Expo. Designed for students to manage daily tasks, track expenses, take rich-text notes, and visualize spending habits with interactive charts. The app stores data locally (AsyncStorage) and supports export/import of expenses and backups. Built with Expo Router, Zustand, react-native-pell-rich-editor, and react-native-chart-kit.
